About Eden Resort

One villa, one view no one else has.

Eden Resort is built facing the Gede and Pangrango mountain range — every room, terrace, and corner of the cafe is aimed at the same point on the horizon. Mist rolls into the valley each morning; at night the lights of Cipanas flicker in the distance.

Warm timber structures meet exposed brick and open gardens, designed for guests who come not just to stay, but to pause and look.
